headSubject: wip(sample): ride-hailing driver script finds the new ride (list is {content}), drops field-scoped price fields on driver PUT; setup+roles+offer+pay green, 69/74 overall
summary: Ride-hailing S2 stage 20 (offer flow) fixed and green 32/32. Root causes were platform bugs, all fixed in kernel with tests (commit 3fdf044e): (1) an await nested in a branch/forEach recorded a trace COUNT as its resume index (inflated by earlier nested steps) so resume restarted at the wrong top-level step -> now StepExecutionRequest.anchorIndex = enclosing top-level step; (2) quiet-wait resume back-off could push a timed await's expiry far past its deadline (20 s offer fired ~38 s) -> clamped to the deadline in ResumeCoordinator.applyResumeBackoff; (3) callProcedure output held ConceptRecord objects so a flow condition on $m.data.status was false until the flow had parked once -> CallProcedureStep.plainTree. FLOWS.md has a new 'Where a parked await resumes' section. Sample model: one forEach over free drivers (OfferCandidates, max 3 rounds), MatchDriver re-run is a no-op unless REQUESTED; kit delta 20-offer-timeout updated in OutsideRepo. drive_s2.py: ride lookup reads {content}, drops field-scoped price fields on driver PUT. Full run of run-ride-hailing.ps1 -Stages all: 69/74 (setup, roles, offer, pay, rate, notify, route green).
nextStep: Fix the 5 remaining red checks in D:\WorkSpace\NPDev\NPDev_General\NPDevSamples\ride-hailing (run: pwsh -NoProfile -File D:\WorkSpace\NPDev\NPDev_General\scripts\quality\run-ride-hailing.ps1 -Stages all -ReuseBuild, but -ReuseBuild needs Output\App which clean-workspace-state.ps1 deletes, so run once without it; env DRIVE_DETAIL_CHARS=1200 for detail): (a) paymore[tok_async] stays PROCESSING after 25 s -- webhook payment.succeeded not applied (check the mock PSP webhook-url and /api/hooks/psp handling, other 3 paymore cases pass); (b) price: '4 open requests vs 1 free driver -> demand 2.5' and 'surge = 3.0' fail because with the forEach offer flow the extra requests become NO_DRIVER at once instead of staying open -- rework the price stage (or keep the requests open) so openNearby/freeNearby count; (c) cancel: rider2 can claim the DRIVER cancelled (200, must be refused) and rider2.cancelsByRider stays 0. Then register run-ride-hailing.ps1 (scripts/policy/script-inventory-policy.json, script-invocation-declarations.json, scripts/quality/verification-cadence.json id ride-hailing-s2; run scripts/quality/run-script-inventory-check.ps1 and check-cadence-coverage.py), then P2..P6 and Z2 from D:\WorkSpace\NPDev\NPDev_General__OutsideRepo\RIDE_HAILING_S2_PLAN_2026-11-11\impl\TASKS.md, and create ledger items REG-328+ (not created yet; include the three kernel fixes above). The kit staging command is python -I D:\WorkSpace\NPDev\NPDev_General__OutsideRepo\RIDE_HAILING_S2_PLAN_2026-11-11\impl\tools\stage.py --upto 95 --out D:\WorkSpace\NPDev\NPDev_General__OutsideRepo\scratch-s2\s95 (kit deltas are the source; sample Input\model.json is currently the staged s95 model).
